# State diagram syntax

<!-- Generated by tools/gen-grammar from packages/diagram-state/grammar/state.ebnf. Do not edit: run `pnpm gen:grammar`. -->

State diagram syntax (R-PARSE-9, D54): the normative grammar of `stateDiagram` and
`stateDiagram-v2` diagrams, which are the same language (D101).

The hand-written parser in `src/parser/` implements it; `tools/gen-grammar` builds a reference
parser, a sentence generator, highlighters and the syntax reference page from it. mermaid@12
decides what is valid, this file is fixed to match, and the parser must match this file
(DESIGN §4.4).

**Lexer input.** The lexer reads the diagram body as mermaid@12 handed it to its lexer: front
matter and `%%{…}%%` directives removed; CRLF read as LF; `="x"` inside an HTML tag read as
`='x'`; `%%` comment lines removed and leading blanks trimmed; on a line with
`style…:…#…;` (or `classDef…`) the last `;` dropped; `#name;` / `#123;` entities kept as
opaque text that no rule matches as `#`; and a line break appended. Keywords match in any case.

**Statements** need no separator: a line break is a statement of its own, so `A B` is two
states. Inside a composite state line breaks are not tokens at all.

## Grammar

EBNF: `[ x ]` is optional, `{ x }` repeats zero or more times, `x+` one or more times, `|` separates alternatives. Upper-case names and `subgraph`, `end`, `acc_…`, `direction_…` are tokens (see below). A rule marked `@Type` builds an AST node of that type.

A diagram is the header, then statements; line breaks are statements too.

```ebnf
stateDiagram = { NL | END_OF_INPUT } Header document ;
```

```ebnf
Header @Header = SD ;
```

```ebnf
document = { statement | NL | END_OF_INPUT } ;
```

```ebnf
statement = Plain
          | Transition
          | Declared
          | Composite
          | Described
          | Pseudo
          | Divider
          | Note
          | ClassDef
          | Style
          | Class
          | Direction
          | AccTitle
          | AccDescr
          | Click
          | HideEmpty
          | Scale ;
```

```ebnf
idStatement = ( ID | EDGE_STATE ) [ STYLE_SEPARATOR ID ] ;
```

A state on its own, with an optional description.

```ebnf
Plain @State = idStatement [ DESCR ] ;
```

A transition with an optional label.

```ebnf
Transition @Transition = end ARROW end [ DESCR ] ;
```

```ebnf
end @State = idStatement ;
```

`state X` on its own declares nothing (v12 draws no state for it).

```ebnf
Declared @State = COMPOSITE_STATE ;
```

`state X { … }` or `state "description" as X { … }`: a composite state; `--` splits it into
concurrent regions.

```ebnf
Composite @Composite = COMPOSITE_STATE STRUCT_START document STRUCT_STOP
                     | STATE_DESCR AS ID STRUCT_START document STRUCT_STOP ;
```

`state "description" as X`: a state with a description.

```ebnf
Described @State = STATE_DESCR AS ID ;
```

`state f <<fork>>`, `<<join>>`, `<<choice>>` (or `[[fork]]` …): a pseudo-state.

```ebnf
Pseudo @State = FORK
              | JOIN
              | CHOICE ;
```

`--` splits a composite state into concurrent regions.

```ebnf
Divider @Divider = CONCURRENT ;
```

`note left of A : text`, or `note right of A`, the text on the lines after it, then
`end note`. A floating `note "text" as N` is accepted and not drawn.

```ebnf
Note @Note = note ( left_of | right_of ) target NOTE_TEXT
           | note NOTE_TEXT AS ID ;
```

```ebnf
target @State = ID ;
```

`classDef name fill:#f96,color:#000`: defines a class of styles.

```ebnf
ClassDef @ClassDef = classDef ( CLASSDEF_ID | DEFAULT ) CLASSDEF_STYLEOPTS ;
```

`style A,B fill:#f96`: styles states.

```ebnf
Style @Style = style STYLE_IDS STYLEDEF_STYLEOPTS ;
```

`class A,B name`: gives states a class, as `A:::name` does.

```ebnf
Class @Class = class CLASSENTITY_IDS STYLECLASS ;
```

`direction TB`, `BT`, `RL` or `LR`: the direction of the diagram, or of the composite state
it is in.

```ebnf
Direction @Direction = direction_tb
                     | direction_bt
                     | direction_rl
                     | direction_lr ;
```

`accTitle: …`: the accessible title of the diagram.

```ebnf
AccTitle @AccTitle = acc_title acc_title_value ;
```

`accDescr: …` or `accDescr { … }`: the accessible description of the diagram.

```ebnf
AccDescr @AccDescr = acc_descr acc_descr_value
                   | acc_descr_multiline_value ;
```

`click <state> "url" "tooltip"` or `click <state> href "url"`: makes the state a link.

```ebnf
Click @Click = CLICK idStatement ( STRING STRING | HREF STRING ) ( NL | END_OF_INPUT ) ;
```

`hide empty description`: accepted and ignored.

```ebnf
HideEmpty @HideEmpty = HIDE_EMPTY ;
```

`scale 200 width`: accepted and ignored.

```ebnf
Scale @Scale = scale WIDTH ;
```

## Tokens

The lexer works in modes (`INITIAL` and the ones below). In each mode it tries the rules in this order and takes the first that matches; a rule may push a mode or pop back to the previous one. Rules without a token emit nothing.

Modes: `INITIAL`, `STATE`, `STATE_STRING`, `STATE_ID`, `SCALE`, `acc_title`, `acc_descr`, `acc_descr_multiline`, `CLASSDEF`, `CLASSDEFID`, `CLASS`, `CLASS_STYLE`, `STYLE`, `STYLEDEF_STYLES`, `NOTE`, `NOTE_ID`, `NOTE_TEXT`, `FLOATING_NOTE`, `FLOATING_NOTE_ID`, `struct`.

| Modes | Token | Pattern | Action | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| INITIAL | CLICK | `(?i:click)\b` |  | `click <state> "url" "tooltip"` or `click <state> href "url"`: makes the state a link. |
| INITIAL | HREF | `(?i:href)\b` |  |  |
| INITIAL | STRING | `"[^"]*"` |  |  |
| INITIAL | DEFAULT | `(?i:default)\b` |  |  |
| INITIAL | direction_tb | `(?i:.*direction\s+tb)[^\n]*` |  | `direction TB`, `BT`, `RL` or `LR`: the direction of the diagram, or of the composite state it is in. The whole line is the statement, wherever `direction` stands in it. |
| INITIAL | direction_bt | `(?i:.*direction\s+bt)[^\n]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | direction_rl | `(?i:.*direction\s+rl)[^\n]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | direction_lr | `(?i:.*direction\s+lr)[^\n]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | NL | `\n+` |  |  |
| INITIAL | — | `\s+` |  |  |
| STATE, struct | — | `(?:(?!\n)\s)+` |  |  |
| INITIAL, STATE, struct | — | `#[^\n]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL, STATE, struct | — | `%%(?!\{)[^\n]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | scale | `(?i:scale)\s+` | push(SCALE) | `scale 200 width`: accepted and ignored. |
| SCALE | WIDTH | `\d+` |  |  |
| SCALE | — | `\s+(?i:width)\b` | pop |  |
| INITIAL | acc_title | `(?i:accTitle)\s*:\s*` | push(acc_title) | `accTitle: …`: the accessible title of the diagram. |
| acc_title | acc_title_value | `[^\n]*` | pop |  |
| INITIAL | acc_descr | `(?i:accDescr)\s*:\s*` | push(acc_descr) | `accDescr: …` or `accDescr { … }`: the accessible description of the diagram. |
| acc_descr | acc_descr_value | `[^\n]*` | pop |  |
| INITIAL | — | `(?i:accDescr)\s*\{\s*` | push(acc_descr_multiline) |  |
| acc_descr_multiline | — | `\}` | pop |  |
| acc_descr_multiline | acc_descr_multiline_value | `[^}]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL, struct | classDef | `(?i:classDef)\s+` | push(CLASSDEF) | `classDef name fill:#f96,color:#000`: defines a class of styles. `default` is not a class name here. |
| CLASSDEF | DEFAULT_CLASSDEF_ID | `(?i:default)\s+` | pop push(CLASSDEFID) |  |
| CLASSDEF | CLASSDEF_ID | `\w+\s+` | pop push(CLASSDEFID) |  |
| CLASSDEFID | CLASSDEF_STYLEOPTS | `[^\n]*` | pop |  |
| INITIAL, struct | class | `(?i:class)\s+` | push(CLASS) | `class A,B name`: gives states a class, as `A:::name` does. |
| CLASS | CLASSENTITY_IDS | `\w+(?:,\s*\w+)*` | pop push(CLASS_STYLE) |  |
| CLASS_STYLE | STYLECLASS | `[^\n]*` | pop |  |
| INITIAL, struct | style | `(?i:style)\s+` | push(STYLE) | `style A,B fill:#f96`: styles states. |
| STYLE | STYLE_IDS | `[\w,]+\s+` | pop push(STYLEDEF_STYLES) |  |
| STYLEDEF_STYLES | STYLEDEF_STYLEOPTS | `[^\n]*` | pop |  |
| INITIAL, struct | — | `(?i:state)\s+` | push(STATE) | `state X { … }`, `state "description" as X`, `state x <<fork>>`: declares a state. |
| STATE | — | `(?i:<<(?:fork\|join\|choice)>>\|\[\[(?:fork\|join\|choice)\]\])` | pop |  |
| STATE | FORK | `(?i:.*(?=<<fork>>))` |  | `state f <<fork>>`, `<<join>>`, `<<choice>>` (or `[[fork]]` …): a pseudo-state. |
| STATE | JOIN | `(?i:.*(?=<<join>>))` |  |  |
| STATE | CHOICE | `(?i:.*(?=<<choice>>))` |  |  |
| STATE | FORK | `(?i:.*(?=\[\[fork\]\]))` |  |  |
| STATE | JOIN | `(?i:.*(?=\[\[join\]\]))` |  |  |
| STATE | CHOICE | `(?i:.*(?=\[\[choice\]\]))` |  |  |
| struct | direction_tb | `(?i:.*direction\s+tb)[^\n]*` |  |  |
| struct | direction_bt | `(?i:.*direction\s+bt)[^\n]*` |  |  |
| struct | direction_rl | `(?i:.*direction\s+rl)[^\n]*` |  |  |
| struct | direction_lr | `(?i:.*direction\s+lr)[^\n]*` |  |  |
| STATE | — | `"` | push(STATE_STRING) |  |
| STATE | AS | `\s*(?i:as)\s+` | push(STATE_ID) |  |
| STATE_ID | — | `%%[^\n{]*` |  | An id holding `%%` ends before it. |
| STATE_ID | ID | `(?:[^\n{%]\|%(?!%))*` | pop |  |
| STATE_STRING | — | `"` | pop |  |
| STATE_STRING | STATE_DESCR | `[^"]*` |  |  |
| STATE | MULTI_WORD_STATE | `\w+\s+\w+.*?(?=\{)` |  | A state name is one word: v12 throws here. The `{` is read on as in a valid one. |
| STATE | COMPOSITE_STATE | `[^\n\s{]+` |  |  |
| STATE | — | `\n` | pop |  |
| INITIAL, STATE | STRUCT_START | `\{` | pop push(struct) | `{` and `}` around the statements of a composite state. |
| struct | STRUCT_STOP | `\}` | pop |  |
| struct | — | `\n` |  |  |
| INITIAL, struct | note | `(?i:note)\s+` | push(NOTE) | `note left of A : text`, or `note right of A`, the text on the lines after it, then `end note`. |
| NOTE | left_of | `(?i:left of)\b` | pop push(NOTE_ID) |  |
| NOTE | right_of | `(?i:right of)\b` | pop push(NOTE_ID) |  |
| NOTE | — | `"` | pop push(FLOATING_NOTE) |  |
| FLOATING_NOTE | AS | `\s*(?i:as)\s*` | pop push(FLOATING_NOTE_ID) |  |
| FLOATING_NOTE | — | `"` |  |  |
| FLOATING_NOTE | NOTE_TEXT | `[^"]*` |  |  |
| FLOATING_NOTE_ID | ID | `(?:[^\n%]\|%(?!%))*` | pop |  |
| NOTE_ID | ID | `\s*(?:[^:\n\s\-%]\|%(?!%))+` | pop push(NOTE_TEXT) |  |
| NOTE_TEXT | NOTE_TEXT | `\s*:[^:\n;]+` | pop |  |
| NOTE_TEXT | — | `\n\s*(?i:end note)\b` | pop |  |
| NOTE_TEXT | NOTE_TEXT | `[\s\S]*?(?=\n\s*(?i:end note)\b)` |  |  |
| INITIAL | SD | `(?i:stateDiagram)\s+` |  | The header: `stateDiagram` or `stateDiagram-v2`. |
| INITIAL | SD | `(?i:stateDiagram-v2)\s+` |  |  |
| INITIAL | HIDE_EMPTY | `(?i:hide empty description)\b` |  | `hide empty description`: accepted and ignored. |
| INITIAL, struct | EDGE_STATE | `\[\*\]` |  | `[*]`: the start state of the composite (or diagram) it is in, or its end state when a transition goes to it. |
| INITIAL, struct | — | `%%[^:\n\s\-{]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL, struct | ID | `(?:[^:\n\s\-{%]\|%(?!%))+` |  |  |
| INITIAL, struct | DESCR | `\s*:(?:#\w+;\|[^:\n;]\|:[^:\n;])+` |  | `A : text` gives a state a description; after a transition it is the transition's label. An entity's `;` (`#colon;`) does not end it. |
| INITIAL, struct | ARROW | `-->` |  | `A --> B`: a transition. |
| struct | CONCURRENT | `--` |  | `--` splits a composite state into concurrent regions. |
| INITIAL, struct | STYLE_SEPARATOR | `:::` |  | `A:::name`: gives the state a class, as `class A name` does. |
| INITIAL | END_OF_INPUT | `$` |  |  |
| INITIAL | INVALID | `.` |  |  |

Removed before lexing (highlighted only):

- COMMENT: `^[^\S\n]*%%(?!\{)[^\n]+`
- DIRECTIVE: `[^\S\n]*%%\{[\s\S]*?\}%%`
